## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in Typesetter.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] The change does not write or replace Markdown source.
- [ ] Protected technical contexts remain untouched.
- [ ] Each new rule or mapping is independently configurable.
- [ ] Mobile or export claims identify the tested platform and host/exporter.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Focused automated tests added or updated
- [ ] Manual Obsidian surfaces tested where relevant
- [ ] Fixture source confirmed unchanged where relevant
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation remain consistent
- [ ] Notable changes are recorded under `CHANGELOG.md` → `Unreleased`
- [ ] Release versions were not changed without maintainer authorization

List the tested Obsidian versions, platforms, and any untested runtime behavior.

## AI assistance

Disclose material AI assistance and confirm that all generated output was reviewed.
